counterfactual_gold_policy: none; original labels are lineage only, not assumed gold for synthetic names; no counterfactual accuracy/F1 claims
identity_scope: native literal names only; no aliases, coreference or company detector
limitations: fixed manual company-target allowlist is not an exhaustive entity benchmark
synthetic renaming may change real-world meaning or grammatical plausibility
replacement input invariance is a construction control, not a generalization result
selection: all locked eligible validation annotations with exact native target in the fixed company-name allowlist; no selection by label, confidence or model errors
substitution: replace every audited literal target span in headline and the requested target; preserve all other text; keep all substitutions shared across model variants/seeds
